blocking_dependencies: Portfolio: buyer asks for completed WordPress websites and confirmed Kadence experience. GlobalLand has none; none may be invented.
Runtime: no PHP/WordPress/Kadence environment and no authenticated access to a client WordPress admin.
Materials intake: storyboards and branding are design files; the private channel accepts plain text only, no attachments or URL retrieval.
Confidentiality arrangement: needs a signed agreement by a legal person; agents cannot accept contracts.
Application: requires outgoing email to a new recipient; outgoing acquisition is NOT_IMPLEMENTED (operator-only).
not_established: any buyer interest in an AI-produced build
any quote, order or funds; the advertised budget is the buyer’s figure only
bid_handoff: NOT PREPARED: a truthful bid would have to state no completed WordPress sites and no Kadence experience, which fails the stated screening request.
reconsideration_trigger: A WordPress/PHP runtime becomes installed AND an operator-held identity willing to sign confidentiality and send applications exists AND at least one real delivered WordPress site can be cited; or a buyer explicitly accepts AI-built static delivery.
